# watchpoint_export_sink (Resource)

Exports monitoring data every day to your own Azure Blob container (`kind = "azure_blob"`, set `account_url` and `container`) or S3 bucket (`kind = "s3"`, set `bucket`, `region` and, for an S3-compatible store, `endpoint`). Files land at `<prefix>/<dataset>/dt=<date>/`. Requires the data export sinks feature and `settings.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_export_sink" "lake" {
  name              = "Data lake"
  kind              = "s3"
  bucket            = "acme-watchpoint-export"
  region            = "us-east-1"
  datasets          = ["check_results", "monitor_hourly", "alert_events"]
  environment_ids   = [watchpoint_environment.production.id]
  schedule_hour_utc = 3
  secret            = "${var.aws_access_key_id}:${var.aws_secret_access_key}"
}

resource "watchpoint_export_sink" "archive" {
  name        = "Azure archive"
  kind        = "azure_blob"
  account_url = "https://acmearchive.blob.core.windows.net"
  container   = "watchpoint"
  format      = "csv"
  datasets    = ["monitors", "incidents"]
  secret      = var.archive_sas_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datasets` (Set of String) Datasets to export: `check_results`, `monitor_hourly`, `monitors`, `alert_events`, `incidents`.
- `kind` (String) `azure_blob` or `s3`. Changing it replaces the sink.
- `name` (String) Display name (120 characters max).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Credential. Azure Blob: a SAS token or connection string. S3: `accessKeyId:secretAccessKey`. Write-only: only its last four characters are returned (`secret_hint`), so a credential changed outside Terraform is not detected.

### Optional

- `account_url` (String) Azure Blob: the storage account URL, such as `https://account.blob.core.windows.net`.
- `bucket` (String) S3: the bucket name.
- `container` (String) Azure Blob: the container name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Run the daily export. Defaults to `true`.
- `endpoint` (String) S3: the https endpoint of an S3-compatible store. Omit for AWS.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Limit the export to these environments (`watchpoint_environment` ids). Omit for every environment.
- `force_path_style` (Boolean) S3: use path-style addressing, which most S3-compatible stores need. Defaults to `false`.
- `format` (String) `ndjson` (gzip) or `csv`. Defaults to `ndjson`.
- `prefix` (String) Path prefix inside the container or bucket. Defaults to `watchpoint`.
- `region` (String) S3: the bucket region, such as `us-east-1`.
- `schedule_hour_utc` (Number) UTC hour (0 to 23) the daily export runs. Defaults to `2`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Sink ID.
- `secret_hint` (String) Last four characters of the stored credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_export_sink.lake sink_0192f0c1
```
